subject: u_jane

payload.title: docs: agent-api listens on 8100, not 8000
payload.body: The quickstart still names the pre-0.12 port. Compose and the Settings default both say 8100.

patches.diff:
@@ -12,1 +12,1 @@
-agent-api listens on port 8000
+agent-api listens on port 8100

rationale: docs/quickstart.md names port 8000; deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml and shared/config.py both bind agent-api to 8100 — the doc misleads every new self-hoster.
